name: Cranberry-Walnut Goat Cheese Balls with Cinnamon Flatbread & Apple

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Place both cheeses in a medium bowl. Use a fork to mash and combine the cheese mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (113 g) logs goat cheese
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the cheese into rounded balls and place on a large plate. Place plate in the refrigerator until cheese balls are firm, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drizzle flatbreads with maple syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cut flatbreads into wedges and transfer to the baking sheet, syrup-side up.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 flatbreads or naan
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place flatbread in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crisp, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the flatbread is baking, finely chop cranberries and walnuts. Place both in a small bowl, then stir to combine the topping and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup dried cranberries
¾ cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; thinly slice.
When the cheese balls are firm, remove from the fridge and roll in the topping, pressing gently to adhere.
To serve, divide cheese balls, apple slices, and flatbread wedges between plates. Enjoy!
